importMethod: Git tree snapshot with the local adaptations listed below; no nested Git repository or submodule.
localChanges: The Windows Magpie executable is stored in 17 consecutive gzip archive parts, plugins/our-free-model-assets/magpie-win32-x64.exe.gz.part01 through magpie-win32-x64.exe.gz.part17, and restored byte-for-byte with SHA-256 verification by scripts/prepare-our-free-model.mjs during pnpm install without downloading the executable.
scripts/forward-test.mjs uses a scoped DNS fixture instead of public DNS for its offline routable-address rejection test.
scripts/channel-pack-test.mjs replaces the removed optional LLM invariant test plugin with equivalent explicit stream assertions and the current public lossless stream recorder.

src/subscriptions.js requires OUR_FREE_MODEL_GEMINI_CLIENT_SECRET only when imported Gemini CLI subscription credentials need token refresh, retaining the default public client ID without an embedded client secret.

vendor/channel-pack/src/gemini-oauth.ts requires CMDC_PAK_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET for Gemini login or token refresh, retaining the default public client ID and optional CMDC_PAK_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID override without an embedded client secret.
vendor/channel-pack/pack.js and packages/standalone/channels/business.mjs are regenerated with the original build tooling to include the Gemini OAuth configuration changes.
scripts/subscriptions-test.mjs, scripts/channel-pack-test.mjs, and scripts/channel-network-test.mjs use isolated OAuth client fixtures and verify missing/configured client-secret behavior.
updatePolicy: Review and commit plugin changes in this repository. The source overlay enforces managed distribution; upstream self-update is disabled.
